patterns.note: The entire site is structured as a series of terminal-like windows, each containing a project or information section, creating a consistent retro computing aesthetic.
A pixelated, monospaced font is used for all text, with larger, more pronounced pixelated text for headings, reinforcing the retro terminal theme.
A high-contrast color scheme of dark background, vibrant green primary text, and bright orange accents is used consistently, mimicking classic CRT monitors.
Sections appear to fade in or slide up from the bottom as the user scrolls, simulating new output appearing in a terminal window.
Each project entry is encapsulated within a distinct 'terminal window' component, complete with a title bar and window controls, providing clear visual separation and thematic consistency.

technique_notes: The site simulates a retro command-line interface, where all content is presented within dark, rectangular frames resembling terminal windows. These frames feature a title bar with window control dots and a command prompt-like header.
Typography is rendered using a monospaced font, with larger headings employing a pixelated style to enhance the retro computer aesthetic.

Content sections are revealed using a scroll-triggered animation, where each 'terminal window' fades in and slides slightly upwards as it enters the viewport, mimicking new information being printed to the screen.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, pixelated display headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual breaks, while body text maintains a consistent monospaced character.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its complete and immersive emulation of a retro command-line interface. Every element, from typography and color scheme to layout and motion, is meticulously crafted to maintain this theme, making it feel less like a website and more like an interactive terminal session.
